articles.title: HUGE COMEBACK IN KC
articles.body: On the Monday Night Brawl, after being down 22-0, the Kansas City Chiefs come from behind and score 24 unanswered points against the Atlanta Falcons. Kansas City is now currently 4-1, and Atlanta is 3-2. The Chiefs are in playoff position, at 2nd in the AFC and 5th overall, and are sitting at the 5-seed in the AFC Playoff Picture. The Falcons are currently in 8th in the NFC and in 11th overall.

articles.title: Big Game for Indy
articles.body: The Rookie Wayne Chrebet made his first start for Indianapolis in their most recent game (a 21-10 victory) against the Minnesota Vikings. He played the whole game, scoring 3 TDs. The Colts are now 2-3 and are sitting in 8th in the AFC and 17th overall. The Vikings are now 0-5, sitting in last in the NFC and overall.

articles.title: Nothing But Flags Flying During Commanders/Titans Game
articles.body: Nothing but flags flew during the recent game between the Titans and Commanders. A total of eleven penalties were called (mostly personal fouls) in the bloodbath of that game. The Commanders had one illegal hit below the waist penalty, adding up to fifteen total penalty yards. The Titans had ten penalties called. Six late-hit out-of-bounds calls, one targeting, and three encroachment calls, adding up to one hundred ten penalty yards. One of the late hits resulted in Brian Robinson Jr., a third-year out of Alabama, getting injured. Two Titans players "personal fouled out" by committing three personal fouls: Bruce Matthews (Rookie) and DeAndre Hopkins (Second Year). One was disqualified due to targeting: Steve McNair, a third-year. All three players are facing one to three week suspensions, at the league's and team's discretion. As a result of three players getting disqualified, the Titans coach also had to go to the locker room for the last ninety seconds. The final score was Titans: 26, Commanders: 24.

articles.title: Brian Robinson Jr. on IR
articles.body: Brian Robinson Jr. left the recent game versus the Titans after a late hit. He has been placed on the 4-week IR for a mild concussion.
